The '''cathedral ship''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] used by the [[Pius Dea]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

== Characteristics ==
Cathedral ships were massive warships. Their tall towers, religious statues, and gargoyle-decorated weapon emplacements gave them the appearance of floating cathedrals.<ref name="EGW" /> 

==History==
The cathedral ships were used by the [[Pius Dea]] to subjugate [[Alien/Legends|alien]] worlds during the [[Pius Dea Crusades]]. Due to a culture of nepotism and patronage within the Pius-Dea controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] bureaucracy, they were commanded by missionaries and manned by descendants of the original [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] crew who had joined the sect. By the [[11,500s BBY]], cathedral ships darkened the skies of millions of worlds. The names of cathedral ships such as ''[[Illorbion's Hammer]]'', ''[[Shining Pathway]]'', and [[Glory of Kamgeddon|''Glory of Kamgeddon'']] evoked dread on worlds they had once imprisoned. The cathedral ships became the centerpiece of the Republic's new network of [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depots]] along the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rim Frontier]]. The O/RDs served as home bases for the cathedral ships as they pushed beyond the frontier into alien chaos.<ref name="EGW" />

In [[10,966 BBY]], the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] were convinced to abandon their neutrality and secretly seeded the cathedral ships with rogue [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] codes. Once BoSS sent out the signal, thousands upon thousands of Pius Dea warships randomly jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], becoming stranded in interstellar space. This navicode also disabled their navicomputers, supralight engines and communications systems. Unable to restart their [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] and re-enter [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], many of the Pius Dea crew trapped aboard perished from starvation. The cathedral ships of the Pius Dea vanguard, however, emerged at [[Uquine/Legends|Uquine]] where they found themselves utterly inoperative and under the guns of a vast fleet of [[Renunciates|Renunciate]] battleships. The helpless cathedral ships were methodically [[Battle of Uquine|destroyed]], and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex XIX]] was seized by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the bridge of the ''[[Flame of Sinthara]].'' Within a few generations, the Pius Dea faith had been thoroughly purged from the Republic. The last adherents of the faith existed only on those doomed cathedral ships that were left drifting in the void.<ref name="EGW" />
